This is a hindi keyboard popup plugin for TinyMCE 2 RC4

Installation instructions
--------------------------
-Copy the "hindi" directory to the plugins directory of TinyMCE (/jscripts/tiny_mce/plugins). 
-Add plugin to TinyMCE plugin option list example: plugins : "hindi". 

Initialization Example
--------------------------

tinyMCE.init({
	theme : "advanced",
	mode : "textareas",
	plugins : "hindi"
});
